name: smwmusic-toontown-online-bossbot-hq-variation
title: Toontown Online - Bossbot HQ [Variation 1]
description:
A very eerie song from the courtyard of the final boss area of the now defunct MMORPG Toontown Online (and is now still being used in the game's fan-made revival, Toontown Rewritten). This will best fit eerie, unsettling environments.

July 10, 2016 update: Re-did the port entirely, as the original port was terrible.
